data.rationale: The proposal matches the overall procedure and order (two xe.com conversions to USD, timeanddate city lookup, mail draft to procurement@example.com with the subject and body format), but it ends with "Send or discard" where the true workflow says never send and always Discard. It also describes the city as the cheaper supplier's, which is wrong, and it splits each quote into amount and currency parameters, which only roughly matches the single quote_a and quote_b. A browser automation could still be built from it, but the Send ambiguity is a safety risk.
